cost_coverage.attribution_rule: Attribute every relevant contributor to the coordinator intervals t0..tR, tR..tW, tW..tF, or use a justified conservative overcount across intervals. Source-helper names or child RELEASE receipt are not interval boundaries.
cost_coverage.pre_tR_worker_rule: Worker may consume RELEASE/newline and run imports, suite, observers, children or finalization before coordinator RELEASE-close tR. Tpre must cover that work or a proven conservative bound; never place all post-receipt worker work exclusively in Tworker by assumption.
cost_coverage.finally_rule: Tpost includes cleanup, fresh inputs, evidence parse/validation, package listing/size checks and success-path finally/context/launch writes/closes through actual return tF.
cost_coverage.observation_rule: Physical exit-to-wait-return service stays in Tworker, including coordinator dispatch/observe/reap/return latency for an already-exited worker. Keep exact-True tW unchanged.
cost_coverage.CPU_wall_rule: Declare the process/service domain and compatible units before proof. Parallel-process CPU sum, elapsed wall and waiting/denied service differ. Prove disjoint complete coverage or a conservative additive wall upper bound; no unproved subtraction of overlap.
cost_coverage.noncopy_rule: Include projection, JSON/Unicode, hashes/sorts, original code, native calls, locks, allocation, GC/destruction and process service. Unknown work or wait is not0 and cannot be paid by an unproved reserve.
cost_coverage.input_byte_rule: I122 worker/coordinator input file-byte envelopes are separate ledgers, not CPU/time units, all-IO bounds or automatic phase splits. New capture inputs require exact rebind and recalculation.
